snippet.title: Night Errand - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Solve crimes by night and brew coffee between investigations in Night Errand, a story-driven 2D detective game following Sage and Nur in the small town of Morrowpines.

Switch between both detectives as you investigate crime scenes, collect clues, question suspects and combine their different perspectives to solve murder cases. Between investigations, return to your cozy café to brew coffee, examine the evidence and draw new conclusions.

With a focus on exploration, dialogue and deduction, Night Errand combines individual criminal cases with an ongoing story about trust, relationships and the past that continues to haunt its two detectives.

Wishlist Night Errand now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3881710/Night_Errand/

Coming to PC and Mac in late 2027.
